foundation_name: Evidence-Bound Vertical AI Certification Foundation V1
responsibility: Design evidence-to-certification Vertical AI capacity that certifies validation integrity and boundaries without mutating Platform Core or CIL

components.name: Certification Context
components.responsibility: Assemble a read-only certification context from validation runtime outputs, Platform Core, CIL, Repository Intelligence, and certified connector snapshots.

components.name: Certification Selector
components.responsibility: Select which validation results, contracts, and boundaries to certify using repository-first, evidence-first priority; never invents unauthorized writes.

components.name: Certification Rules
components.responsibility: Declare reusable, deterministic certification rules for contracts, boundaries, integrity, and record issuance without owning source data.

components.name: Certification Contract
components.responsibility: Declare the certification boundary contract: consumes PC/CIL/RI/certified connectors/validation runtime only; forbids PC/CIL mutation and unapproved repository mutation.

components.name: Certification Boundary
components.responsibility: Define certified certification boundaries: no PC/CIL mutation, certified connectors only, validation integrity required, write authorization blocked.

components.name: Certification Evidence
components.responsibility: Bind fingerprints and refs so every certification conclusion is preceded by validation and execution evidence.

components.name: Certification Traceability
components.responsibility: Maintain evidence-to-certification traceability from validation outputs through rules, contract/boundary checks, record design, and approval readiness.

components.name: Certification Reproducibility
components.responsibility: Ensure identical evidence and validation inputs yield identical certification design fingerprints across dual runs.

components.name: Certification Record
components.responsibility: Design the certification record shape binding validation fingerprints, boundary integrity, and contract conformance for future certification runtime issuance.

components.name: Certification Runtime Reference
components.responsibility: Reference the certified surfaces future Certification Runtime will bind (validation runtime, Agent Runtime, CIL); reference-only, no mutation.

components.name: Approval Gate
components.responsibility: Require explicit human approval before any repository mutation that certification might later recommend; foundation runs remain read-only.

components.name: Certification Integrity
components.responsibility: Codify and design integrity checks for certified certification boundaries across Platform Core, CIL, connectors, validation integrity, and repository mutation gates.
